reason: Both impose immediate compliance when asking an unfamiliar peer for a nonurgent discretionary favor. Imperative and must wording are different realizations of the same interpersonal requesting calibration, distinct from the temporal and uncertainty dimensions.
pattern_label: Tone calibrated to discretionary peer requests
pattern_description: The learner has used demanding wording for favors from unfamiliar peers who have no obligation to comply. These contexts support a pattern of request tone mismatched to the relationship and degree of imposition, rather than a ban on direct requests generally.
conversation_contexts: Ask a new colleague for help with a shared task
Request access to another person's notes while respecting their availability
